# Contributing to Sleeker

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Sleeker!

We welcome bug reports, feature suggestions, performance
improvements, documentation updates, and code contributions.

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a new branch for your changes.
3. Implement your changes.
4. Test your changes thoroughly.
5. Submit a Pull Request with a clear description.

## Development Requirements

- Java 25 or later
- Gradle (wrapper included)
- Git

## Pull Requests

- Keep changes focused and well-documented.
- Follow the existing code style.
- Include tests for bug fixes and new features.
- Describe the motivation behind your changes.
